purpose: Record the bounded connect-only sampling extension to R5 runtime diagnostics and its aggregate-only redacted export.

source.snapshot: Implementation, tests and documentation were modified together before the recorded checks.

scope: Explicit bounded connect sampling, aggregate timing evidence, aggregate-only support export, focused tests and user/status documentation. No installed application or runtime was selected or changed.
implementation: Added an explicit --samples argument bounded to integers 1 through 8 with the current single-sample behavior as the default.
Repeated the existing bounded zero-byte Unix-socket connect per selected endpoint and timed only that operation with monotonic_ns.
Added aggregate and per-classification nearest-rank p50/p95/p99/max distributions in milliseconds plus sample, success and timeout counts.
Classified timeout errors, including TimeoutError, without interpreting socket content or attempting protocol negotiation.
Kept health unknown and labeled the measurements as local connect diagnostics, not health, protocol compatibility, workload capacity or resource acceptance.
Selected support-export fields explicitly so it exposes aggregate distributions and counters only, never endpoint timing, endpoint paths or session identities.
